newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: Abu Dhabi in $19mln deal for airport radar system.
newsitem.headline: Abu Dhabi in $19mln deal for airport radar system.

text.p: Abu Dhabi's Department of Civil Aviation said it has signed a deal with Aeroports de Paris for the installation of a new radar system at its Abu Dhabi and Al Ain airports.
In a statement it said the systems would satisfy the future needs of air traffic control to the year 2010.
"It is for around 70 million dirhams," Civil Aviation Director of Engineering Abdullah Bilhaif said.

A primary radar system with a minimum range of 120 nautical miles will be installed at Abu Dhabi airport and another with a range of 60 nautical miles will be installed at Al Ain airport. Al Ain will also get a monopulse secondary surveillance radar.

"This integrated radar system employing the latest air traffic management software techniques will (provide) air traffic control with a system that will ensure the highest level of safety for all civil and military air movements," it said.
Included in the project is airport surface movement detection equipment for Abu Dhabi airport.
